title: TRNet: Learning with Topographic Priors for VHR Paddy Rice Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2608.04154v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mapping paddy rice from very high resolution (VHR) imagery in mountainous and hilly regions remains challenging because terrain variations alter optical appearance and increase confusion with visually similar vegetation. To address this issue, we propose TRNet for multimodal paddy rice segmentation using 0.5 m GaoJing 1 red green blue (RGB) imagery, a 5 m TanDEM X digital elevation model (DEM), and derived slope information. TRNet employs separate visual and terrain encoders to preserve modality specific representations. At an early encoder stage, the proposed Topographic Energy Spectral Rectification (TESR) performs terrain conditioned low frequency modulation and asymmetric high frequency regulation to suppress steep slope clutter while selectively enhancing rice related cues on compatible low slope regions. translated_title: TRNet：利用地形先验学习进行超高分辨率水稻制图
translated_abstract: 摘要：在山区和丘陵地区，利用超高分辨率（VHR）影像进行稻田制图仍然具有挑战性，因为地形变化会改变光学外观，并增加与视觉上相似植被的混淆。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 TRNet，用于多模态水稻分割，该方法使用 0.5 米高景一号红绿蓝（RGB）影像、5 米 TanDEM-X 数字高程模型（DEM）以及派生的坡度信息。TRNet 采用相互独立的视觉编码器和地形编码器，以保留各模态特定的表征。在编码器的早期阶段，所提出的地形能量谱校正模块（TESR）执行地形条件下的低频调制和非对称高频调节，以抑制陡坡杂波，同时选择性地增强相容低坡度区域中与水稻相关的线索。地形引导的水稻结构解码器（TPSD）进一步整合了语义信息、水稻-背景边界信息以及内部……
tldr: 提出融合RGB影像与DEM地形先验的多模态分割网络TRNet，通过地形能量谱校正（TESR）和地形引导解码器（TPSD），有效抑制陡坡干扰，显著提升山区丘陵地区超高分辨率影像的水稻制图精度。
en_tdlr: TRNet integrates RGB imagery with topographic priors (DEM and slope) through terrain-conditioned spectral rectification and topography-guided decoding, substantially improving VHR paddy rice mapping accuracy in mountainous and hilly regions.
